datasets.name: scorecard
queryLines:
-- Shared CTEs, prepended to every dataset query by build_dashboard.py.
-- Source: MLflow's system tables (runs + their logged metrics) for the shared experiment.
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.experiment_id, r.run_name, r.start_time, r.tags, r.params, r.aggregated_metrics
  FROM system.mlflow.runs_latest r
  JOIN system.mlflow.experiments_latest e
    ON r.workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND r.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
  WHERE e.name = '/Shared/mygpt/mygpt-rag-agent' AND e.delete_time IS NULL
    AND r.delete_time IS NULL AND r.status = 'FINISHED'
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT run_id, run_name, start_time, tags, params, m.metric_name AS metric, m.latest_value AS value
  FROM runs LATERAL VIEW explode(aggregated_metrics) x AS m
),
-- One row per benchmark line of the comparison. `mygpt_rx` matches the reference run's
-- metric(s) for the same scorer: one per MyGPT config (3 for kinase), NULL = no MyGPT figure.
benchmarks AS (
  SELECT * FROM VALUES
    (1, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Yes/no vs SME gold (original wording)', 'yes_no_correct/sme/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/sj_global/answer_1/sme_accuracy$', 'St. Jude SME accuracy of MyGPT answer_1'),
    (2, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Yes/no on reworded questions (Q6-10)', 'yes_no_correct/inherited/mean',
        CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'no MyGPT figure (variants were not SME-graded)'),
    (3, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Answer correctness (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'no MyGPT figure (gold is built from the MyGPT answers SMEs marked Correct)'),
    (4, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q11 expression system', 'expression_system_correct/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/expression_system_correct$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same scorer'),
    (5, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q17 figure references', 'figure_ref_match/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/figure_ref_match$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same scorer'),
    (6, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q16v2 assay type (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/gold_correctness$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same judge'),
    (7, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Yes/no questions (76)', 'yes_no_correct/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/yes_no_correct$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same scorer'),
    (8, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Factoid questions (87)', 'factoid_match/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/factoid_match$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same scorer'),
    (9, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Answer correctness (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/gold_correctness$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same judge')
  AS b(sort, use_case, use_case_label, benchmark, ours_metric, mygpt_rx, mygpt_basis)
),
-- Our agent: full-dataset eval runs (max_rows = 0); rk = 1 is the latest per dataset x model.
ours AS (
  SELECT run_id, start_time, metric, value, params,
         tags['mygpt.eval.use_case'] AS use_case,
         tags['mygpt.eval.model_alias'] AS model_alias,
         CASE regexp_extract(tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'], '([a-z_]+)$', 1)
           WHEN 'eval_health_policies_fr' THEN 'SJ Global (FR)'
           WHEN 'eval_health_policies_es' THEN 'SJ Global (ES)'
           WHEN 'eval_kinase_literature' THEN 'BlueSky kinase'
           WHEN 'eval_bioasq' THEN 'BioASQ'
           ELSE tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'] END AS dataset_label,
         CAST(regexp_extract(tags['mygpt.eval.served_model'], '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS INT) AS agent_version,
         dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'], tags['mygpt.eval.model_alias']
                            ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rk
  FROM metrics
  WHERE tags['mygpt.eval.use_case'] IS NOT NULL AND tags['mygpt.eval.max_rows'] = '0'
),
-- MyGPT: its recorded answers through our scorers (mygpt_eval_reference). Per metric, the
-- latest reference run that logged it (judge=false runs omit the LLM-judge metrics).
mygpt AS (
  SELECT metric, value, regexp_extract(metric, '^mygpt_ref/[^/]+/([^/]+)/', 1) AS config,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rk
  FROM metrics
  WHERE tags['mygpt.eval.kind'] = 'reference'
)
-- One row per benchmark line x dataset (FR / ES are separate rows) x model alias.
, mygpt_by_benchmark AS (
  SELECT b.sort, min(m.value) AS mygpt_min, max(m.value) AS mygpt_best, count(*) AS n_configs,
         array_join(array_sort(collect_list(concat(m.config, ' ', format_number(m.value, 3)))), ', ') AS mygpt_configs
  FROM benchmarks b JOIN mygpt m ON m.rk = 1 AND m.metric RLIKE b.mygpt_rx
  GROUP BY b.sort
),
lines AS (
  SELECT b.sort, b.use_case_label, b.benchmark, b.mygpt_basis, o.dataset_label, o.model_alias,
         o.agent_version, o.start_time AS run_time, o.run_id, o.value AS ours,
         mb.mygpt_best, mb.mygpt_min, mb.n_configs, mb.mygpt_configs,
         CAST(o.params[concat('gate/', b.ours_metric)] AS DOUBLE) AS gate
  FROM benchmarks b
  JOIN ours o ON o.rk = 1 AND o.use_case = b.use_case AND o.metric = b.ours_metric
  LEFT JOIN mygpt_by_benchmark mb ON mb.sort = b.sort
)
SELECT sort, use_case_label, dataset_label, benchmark, model_alias, agent_version, run_time, run_id,
       round(ours, 3) AS ours,
       round(mygpt_best, 3) AS mygpt_best,
       CASE WHEN n_configs > 1 THEN concat(format_number(mygpt_min, 2), ' - ', format_number(mygpt_best, 2))
            ELSE format_number(mygpt_best, 3) END AS mygpt_range,
       mygpt_configs, mygpt_basis,
       round(ours - mygpt_best, 3) AS delta,
       CASE WHEN ours - mygpt_best > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END AS delta_sign,
       CASE WHEN mygpt_best IS NULL THEN '-'
            WHEN ours - mygpt_best > 0.03 THEN 'Better'
            WHEN ours - mygpt_best >= -0.03 THEN 'On par'
            ELSE 'Worse' END AS status,
       CAST(mygpt_best IS NOT NULL AND ours - mygpt_best >= -0.03 AS INT) AS is_at_or_above,
       CAST(mygpt_best IS NOT NULL AND ours - mygpt_best < -0.03 AS INT) AS is_below,
       gate,
       CASE WHEN gate IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN ours >= gate THEN 'Pass' ELSE 'Fail' END AS gate_status,
       CAST(gate IS NOT NULL AND ours >= gate AS INT) AS gate_passed,
       CAST(gate IS NOT NULL AS INT) AS gated,
       concat(dataset_label, ' | ', benchmark) AS line
FROM lines
ORDER BY sort, dataset_label

    AND r.delete_time IS NULL AND r.status = 'FINISHED'
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT run_id, run_name, start_time, tags, params, m.metric_name AS metric, m.latest_value AS value
  FROM runs LATERAL VIEW explode(aggregated_metrics) x AS m
),
-- One row per benchmark line of the comparison. `mygpt_rx` matches the reference run's
-- metric(s) for the same scorer: one per MyGPT config (3 for kinase), NULL = no MyGPT figure.
benchmarks AS (
  SELECT * FROM VALUES
    (1, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Yes/no vs SME gold (original wording)', 'yes_no_correct/sme/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/sj_global/answer_1/sme_accuracy$', 'St. Jude SME accuracy of MyGPT answer_1'),
    (2, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Yes/no on reworded questions (Q6-10)', 'yes_no_correct/inherited/mean',
        CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'no MyGPT figure (variants were not SME-graded)'),
    (3, 'sj_global', 'SJ Global', 'Answer correctness (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'no MyGPT figure (gold is built from the MyGPT answers SMEs marked Correct)'),
    (4, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q11 expression system', 'expression_system_correct/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/expression_system_correct$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same scorer'),
    (5, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q17 figure references', 'figure_ref_match/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/figure_ref_match$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same scorer'),
    (6, 'bluesky', 'BlueSky kinase', 'Q16v2 assay type (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/(ctx5|ctx15|strpre)/gold_correctness$', 'MyGPT ctx5 / ctx15 / strpre, same judge'),
    (7, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Yes/no questions (76)', 'yes_no_correct/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/yes_no_correct$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same scorer'),
    (8, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Factoid questions (87)', 'factoid_match/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/factoid_match$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same scorer'),
    (9, 'bioasq', 'BioASQ', 'Answer correctness (LLM judge)', 'gold_correctness/mean',
        '^mygpt_ref/bioasq/gpt-oss-20b/gold_correctness$', 'MyGPT (gpt-oss-20b), same judge')
  AS b(sort, use_case, use_case_label, benchmark, ours_metric, mygpt_rx, mygpt_basis)
),
-- Our agent: full-dataset eval runs (max_rows = 0); rk = 1 is the latest per dataset x model.
ours AS (
  SELECT run_id, start_time, metric, value, params,
         tags['mygpt.eval.use_case'] AS use_case,
         tags['mygpt.eval.model_alias'] AS model_alias,
         CASE regexp_extract(tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'], '([a-z_]+)$', 1)
           WHEN 'eval_health_policies_fr' THEN 'SJ Global (FR)'
           WHEN 'eval_health_policies_es' THEN 'SJ Global (ES)'
           WHEN 'eval_kinase_literature' THEN 'BlueSky kinase'
           WHEN 'eval_bioasq' THEN 'BioASQ'
           ELSE tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'] END AS dataset_label,
         CAST(regexp_extract(tags['mygpt.eval.served_model'], '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS INT) AS agent_version,
         dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY tags['mygpt.eval.dataset'], tags['mygpt.eval.model_alias']
                            ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rk
  FROM metrics
  WHERE tags['mygpt.eval.use_case'] IS NOT NULL AND tags['mygpt.eval.max_rows'] = '0'
),
-- MyGPT: its recorded answers through our scorers (mygpt_eval_reference). Per metric, the
-- latest reference run that logged it (judge=false runs omit the LLM-judge metrics).
mygpt AS (
  SELECT metric, value, regexp_extract(metric, '^mygpt_ref/[^/]+/([^/]+)/', 1) AS config,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rk
  FROM metrics
  WHERE tags['mygpt.eval.kind'] = 'reference'
)
-- How often each gold scorer agrees with St. Jude's SMEs, on MyGPT's kinase answers.
, agreement AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(metric, '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/([^/]+)/', 1) AS config,
         coalesce(nullif(regexp_extract(metric, '/(sme|sme_realigned)/', 1), ''), 'all') AS gold_slice,
         regexp_extract(metric, '/([a-z_]+)/agreement$', 1) AS scorer,
         value AS agreement,
         regexp_replace(metric, '/agreement$', '/n') AS n_metric
  FROM mygpt WHERE rk = 1 AND metric RLIKE '^mygpt_ref/bluesky/.*/agreement$'
)
SELECT a.config, a.gold_slice, a.scorer,
       CASE a.scorer WHEN 'expression_system_correct' THEN 'Q11 expression system'
                     WHEN 'figure_ref_match' THEN 'Q17 figure references'
                     WHEN 'gold_correctness' THEN 'Q16v2 assay (LLM judge)' END AS question,
       concat(CASE a.scorer WHEN 'expression_system_correct' THEN 'Q11 expression'
                            WHEN 'figure_ref_match' THEN 'Q17 figures' ELSE 'Q16v2 assay (judge)' END,
              ' (', a.gold_slice, ')') AS label,
       round(a.agreement, 3) AS agreement, CAST(n.value AS INT) AS n
FROM agreement a LEFT JOIN mygpt n ON n.rk = 1 AND n.metric = a.n_metric
ORDER BY question, a.config, a.gold_slice

widget.name: header
widget.textbox_spec:
# MyGPT benchmarks: Databricks agent vs. MyGPT
**Databricks agent** = the `mygpt-rag-agent` endpoint as served at its latest **full** eval run (`mygpt_eval`, every row of each dataset).
**MyGPT** = the answers St. Jude's MyGPT recorded in *MyGPT-evaluations*, put through **the same scorers** (`mygpt_eval_reference`; nothing is regenerated).
Scores are accuracies (0-1). **Δ** = ours − MyGPT's best configuration; within ±0.03 counts as *on par*.

frame.title: Δ vs MyGPT (positive = Databricks agent ahead)

widget.name: how_to_read
widget.textbox_spec:
### How to read this
- **SJ Global (health policies, FR / ES):** MyGPT's bar is **St. Jude's SME grading** of MyGPT's `answer_1`. Our yes/no gold is *derived from* those answers (flipped where the SMEs marked them Incorrect), so MyGPT is not re-scored against it. The reworded questions (Q6-10) and the correctness judge have no MyGPT figure.
- **BlueSky (kinase literature):** MyGPT ran three configurations (5 or 15 context chunks, structured pre-prompt); the table shows their range and Δ is against the best. About half the kinase gold comes from a block of St. Jude's file that was shifted by one row and has been realigned (see *Robustness & trust*).
- **BioASQ (public benchmark, 163 questions over all 397 papers):** MyGPT's figure is its gpt-oss-20b run.
- Rows marked *(LLM judge)* use MLflow's correctness judge, which agrees with St. Jude's SMEs 75-84% of the time; treat ±0.05 differences there as noise. The code scorers agree 83-100%.
- **Gate** = the minimum the CI eval enforces for this metric (`eval/gates.yaml`); shown once a run has logged its gates.

widget.name: robustness_md
widget.textbox_spec:
### Robustness: does the answer depend on the wording?
SJ Global questions Q6-10 repeat a base question **without its keyword hints**, and inherit the base question's yes/no gold. A large drop means the agent leans on the hinted vocabulary rather than the policy's meaning.

widget.name: trust_md
widget.textbox_spec:
### Can the scorers be trusted?
Each gold scorer was run on MyGPT's own kinase answers and compared with St. Jude's SME Correct / Incorrect labels.
**≥ 0.85 agreement**: reliable enough to gate on. **< 0.80**: read as indicative only.
`sme` = gold as St. Jude recorded it; `sme_realigned` = gold repaired from the shifted block of their file (agreement there validates the realignment).

frame.title: SJ Global yes/no: original vs reworded
Scorer agreement with SMEs, by MyGPT config
BlueSky per question: Databricks agent vs each MyGPT config

widget.name: trend_md
widget.textbox_spec:
### Trend across agent versions
Every **full** eval run (smoke runs with `max_rows` > 0 are excluded). Gold metrics start at agent v12; the judge metrics go back to v9.
Use the filters to pick a dataset and metrics.
